against.head: Distribution
against.learn: Up days on heavy volume mean institutions are buying; heavy down days (distribution) mean they are selling.
against.text: In five weeks it had 1 up day and 8 down days on volume above both the day before and its average.

PAG.change: A daily close below −3%, under the July breakout level, proves it wrong. So would heavy selling into the buy zone.
considered: Relative strength vs SPY: +6% in 3 months
MACD: crossed above its signal on Oct 15, below zero
Average daily range: 2.1% (normal for its year)
Market: 31% of stocks above their 50-day average and volatility elevated
Liquidity: about 92 million dollars a day
PAG.gist: A stock in an uptrend at support (the average price paid since the Jul 29 high and the 50-day average); it broke out of a 3-week base.

why: a clean wave 2 at its zone

plan.sentence: Buy between −1.6% and +0.3% from the Oct 16 close. Target +6.7%, then +11%. Out on a daily close below −3%.
plan.why_t1: the 52-week high and the Jul 29 high
plan.why_zone: the average price paid since the Jul 29 high, the 50-day average and the 50% retracement of the Jul 29–Oct 13 drop

standouts.head: Broke out of a 3-week base
standouts.learn: A close above a ceiling that capped price before; strongest on heavy volume.
standouts.text: On Oct 16 it closed above the top of a 3-week base (10% deep), on 2.5x average volume.

standouts.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
standouts.learn: After five waves up, the pullback that usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance. The zone is where to watch; a daily close up inside it is the buy. Under the start of wave 1 the count is wrong.
standouts.text: Five clean waves up from Jun 17 to Jul 29 (+33%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−9.4% to −14%), on lighter volume, with the June breakout level in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−19%). A daily close above the wave-1 high (+6.9%) says wave 3 is under way.

standouts.head: Sitting on stacked support
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.
standouts.text: Price sits on the average price paid since the Jul 29 high, the 50-day average and the 50% retracement of the Jul 29–Oct 13 drop: 3 kinds of level at one price.

standouts.head: A breakaway gap up
standouts.learn: A gap out of a range on heavy volume that holds: the start of a move.
standouts.text: On Oct 15 it gapped up out of a tight range on 8.6x volume and has held (+8.3% at the open).

standouts.head: Weekly chart: advancing
standouts.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; the advancing stage (above a rising 30-week average) is where longs pay.
standouts.text: On the weekly chart price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.

PAG.take: PAG: it is pulling back inside an uptrend, and it sits on support at the average price paid since the Jul 29 high and the 50-day average. It broke out of a 3-week base, and it is turning up from its wave-2 zone. Against it, heavy-volume selling outnumbers buying (distribution). This is the kind of setup the desk wants to own.
